The [[Mantis Dreamweaver Polymock Piece]] is one of the 18 pieces that a player can pick while playing [[Polymock]].

When using this piece, you take the [[Mantis Dreamweaver Form]].

[[Category:Polymock pieces]]

==Acquisition==
This piece drops as a reward from [[Arachni's Spoils]], [[Eldritch Chest]] and the [[Zoldark's Chest]].
